transcript_source: session-reader tool if the host exposes one; otherwise the user exports the chat transcript to a .txt and points the agent at it
critical_definition: Defaults (task forgetting; a fixed bug recurs 2+ times; a bug breaks a working feature / dead-loop) PLUS: shipped code that fails the existing test suite; a secret/credential leaked into output
grounding_source: the repo's CHANGELOG + the PR description for the session's branch
exclusions: pure Q&A / explanation sessions with no code change
